name: school_admissions
summary: Applicant pipeline (application to review to assessment to offer/waitlist/reject to accept to enroll), document checklists, append-only decision audit, seat-capacity guard and offer-expiry automation
description: Implements the admissions workflow from the blueprint while honouring the rule that an applicant and an enrolled student are different lifecycle objects. school.applicant moves through a server-validated state machine (draft, submitted, under review, assessment, offered, waitlisted, accepted, rejected, enrolled, cancelled, expired); only the Manager-gated Enroll step creates a school.student and it is blocked when the chosen section has no free seat. school.application.document is a configurable required/received checklist that gates when an offer may be issued, and school.admission.decision is an append-only trail recording every transition, actor and reason. Duplicate-suspect detection compares a trimmed name-plus-date-of-birth fingerprint across applications; a daily cron expires offers and waitlist holds past their expiry date. Application-fee amounts are captured as references only; invoicing and payment stay in the Payments domain and are never duplicated here. Navigated under the single School app.
author: Nexa
